#Recode PATH Variables
```{r Recode PATH susceptibility variables}
# Recode susceptibility: 1 = lowest susceptibility, 4 = highest susceptibility
recode_sus <- function(x) {
  x_num <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x_num), NA, 5 - x_num)
}

# Harmonized PATH Youth susceptibility variables
PATH_youth_sus <- youth %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source = "PATH",
    dataset = "PATH youth",
    group = "Youth",

    # Nicotine pouches
    np_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YA1103NP),
    np_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YA1206NP),
    np_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YA1104NP),
    np_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YA1105NP),

    # Cigarettes
    cig_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YC1103),
    cig_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YC1206),
    cig_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YC1104),
    cig_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YC1105),

    # E-cigarettes / ENDS
    ecig_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YV1103),
    ecig_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YV1206),
    ecig_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YV1104),
    ecig_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YV1105),

    # Hookah
    hookah_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YH1103),
    hookah_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YH1206),
    hookah_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YH1104),
    hookah_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YH1105),

    # Snus
    snus_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YU1103),
    snus_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YU1206),
    snus_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YU1104),
    snus_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YU1105),

    # Smokeless tobacco
    smkls_curious  = recode_sus(R08_YS1103),
    smkls_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YS1206),
    smkls_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YS1104),
    smkls_friend   = recode_sus(R08_YS1105),

    cigar_nextyear = recode_sus(R08_YG9020),
    cigar_soon     = recode_sus(R08_YG9013),
```

```{r PATH broad susceptibility data}
# Product item sets
product_items <- list(
  np = c("np_curious", "np_nextyear", "np_soon", "np_friend"),
  cig = c("cig_curious", "cig_nextyear", "cig_soon", "cig_friend"),
  ecig = c("ecig_curious", "ecig_nextyear", "ecig_soon", "ecig_friend"),
  hookah = c("hookah_curious", "hookah_nextyear", "hookah_soon", "hookah_friend"),
  snus = c("snus_curious", "snus_nextyear", "snus_soon", "snus_friend"),
  smkls = c("smkls_curious", "smkls_nextyear", "smkls_soon", "smkls_friend"),
  cigar = c("cigar_curious", "cigar_nextyear", "cigar_soon", "cigar_friend"),
  cigarillo = c("cigarillo_curious", "cigarillo_nextyear", "cigarillo_soon", "cigarillo_friend"),
  fcigar = c("fcigar_curious", "fcigar_nextyear", "fcigar_soon", "fcigar_friend")
)

# All broad susceptibility item names
broad_sus_items <- unname(unlist(product_items))

# Check that all items exist in PATH_sus_wide
setdiff(broad_sus_items, names(PATH_sus_wide))

# Create PATH-only broad susceptibility analytic dataset
PATH_broad_sus <- PATH_sus_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    source,
    dataset,
    group,
    dplyr::all_of(broad_sus_items)
  )

# Keep respondents with at least one susceptibility item answered
PATH_broad_sus_analytic <- PATH_broad_sus %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(broad_sus_items)))) > 0
  )

# Check sample
table(PATH_broad_sus_analytic$dataset)
summary(PATH_broad_sus_analytic[, broad_sus_items])
```
```{r Broad item descriptive ranges}
# Reproducible item-level descriptives for Results reporting.
# psych::describe() reports excess kurtosis (normal distribution = 0).
broad_item_descriptives <- psych::describe(
  PATH_broad_sus_analytic[, broad_sus_items],
  fast = FALSE
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("item") %>%
  dplyr::select(item, n, mean, sd, skew, kurtosis)

broad_descriptive_ranges <- broad_item_descriptives %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_min = min(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_max = max(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_min = min(sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_max = max(sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    skew_min = min(skew, na.rm = TRUE),
    skew_max = max(skew, na.rm = TRUE),
    kurtosis_min = min(kurtosis, na.rm = TRUE),
    kurtosis_max = max(kurtosis, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ round(.x, 2)))

broad_item_descriptives
broad_descriptive_ranges
```

#Recode IPSOS Youth
```{r Recode}
# Preserve raw IPSOS data
IPSOS_Youth_raw <- IPSOS_Youth

# Identify respondent ID column across IPSOS file versions
ipsos_id_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "ResponseId" %in% names(IPSOS_Youth_raw) ~ "ResponseId",
  "caseid2" %in% names(IPSOS_Youth_raw) ~ "caseid2",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(ipsos_id_col)) stop("No IPSOS respondent ID column found")

# Sus recode function: 1 = lowest susceptibility, 4 = highest susceptibility
recode_ipsos_sus <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_clean %in% c(".", "", "na", "nan") ~ NA_real_,
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "definit") & stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "not") ~ 1,
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "probably not") ~ 2,
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "probably yes") ~ 3,
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "definit") & stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "yes") ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# Create cleaned/re-coded IPSOS Youth object
IPSOS_Youth <- IPSOS_Youth_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    id = .data[[ipsos_id_col]],
    np_curious  = recode_ipsos_sus(NP13),
    np_nextyear = recode_ipsos_sus(NP11),
    np_soon     = recode_ipsos_sus(NP10),
    np_friend   = recode_ipsos_sus(NP12),
    source = "Ipsos youth",
    group = "Youth"
  )

# Check cleaned object
summary(IPSOS_Youth)
table(IPSOS_Youth$np_curious, useNA = "ifany")
table(IPSOS_Youth$np_nextyear, useNA = "ifany")
table(IPSOS_Youth$np_soon, useNA = "ifany")
table(IPSOS_Youth$np_friend, useNA = "ifany")

# Keep only IPSOS respondents with at least one pouch susceptibility item
IPSOS_Youth_analytic <- IPSOS_Youth[rowSums(!is.na(IPSOS_Youth[, c(
  "np_curious",
  "np_nextyear",
  "np_soon",
  "np_friend"
)])) > 0, ]

# Check analytic sample size
dim(IPSOS_Youth_analytic)

# Check distributions
summary(IPSOS_Youth_analytic)

```

#Create Pooled Analytic Sample
```{r Analytic sample}
# PATH pouch-only analytic file
PATH_np_analytic <- np_all_analytic %>%
  dplyr::select(
    np_curious, np_nextyear, np_soon, np_friend,
    source, group, dataset
  )

# IPSOS pouch-only analytic file
IPSOS_Youth_analytic <- IPSOS_Youth_analytic %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source = "Ipsos",
    dataset = "Ipsos youth",
    group = "Youth"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    np_curious, np_nextyear, np_soon, np_friend,
    source, group, dataset
  )

# Master pooled dataset
np_master <- dplyr::bind_rows(PATH_np_analytic, IPSOS_Youth_analytic)

# Remove objects from earlier workflow iterations
rm(
  da36498.8001,
  da36498.8002,
  IPSOS_Youth,
  list = ls(pattern = "^youth_np$|^ya_np$|^youth_np_recoded$|^ya_np_recoded$")
)
```

#Pouch-specific CFA
```{r Pouch susceptibility CFA}
# Define one-factor model
np_model <- '
  np_sus =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend
'

# Fit ordered categorical CFA
fit_np <- cfa(
  model = np_model,
  data = np_master,
  ordered = c("np_curious", "np_nextyear", "np_soon", "np_friend"),
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Model fit and standardized loadings
summary(fit_np, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)


```

```{r Measurement invariance across age groups}
# Convert group to factor
np_master$group <- factor(np_master$group)

# Check group sizes
table(np_master$group, np_master$dataset)

# Configural invariance across age groups
fit_config_age <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = np_model,
  data = np_master,
  group = "group",
  ordered = c("np_curious", "np_nextyear", "np_soon", "np_friend"),
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Loadings + thresholds invariance for ordered items across age groups
fit_thresh_age <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = np_model,
  data = np_master,
  group = "group",
  ordered = c("np_curious", "np_nextyear", "np_soon", "np_friend"),
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise",
  group.equal = c("loadings", "thresholds")
)

# Compare fit
summary(fit_config_age, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
summary(fit_thresh_age, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# Scaled chi-square difference test
lavaan::lavTestLRT(fit_config_age, fit_thresh_age)

# Extract practical fit measures
lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_config_age, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_thresh_age, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))

# Score test for equality constraints
lavaan::lavTestScore(fit_thresh_age)
```

#General vs product-specific CFA
```{r Product-specific CFA models}
# Run one-factor CFA for each product-specific susceptibility scale
product_cfa_results <- lapply(names(product_items), function(prod) {
  
  items <- product_items[[prod]]
  
  model_text <- paste0(
    prod, "_sus =~ ",
    paste(items, collapse = " + ")
  )
  
  fit <- lavaan::cfa(
    model = model_text,
    data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
    ordered = items,
    estimator = "WLSMV",
    missing = "pairwise"
  )
  
  list(
    product = prod,
    fit = fit,
    fit_measures = lavaan::fitMeasures(fit, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
  )
})

# View fit measures
product_cfa_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(product_cfa_results, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    product = x$product,
    t(as.numeric(x$fit_measures))
  )
}))

names(product_cfa_table) <- c("product", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")

product_cfa_table
```
```{r One-factor CFA model}
# Single-factor model: all 36 ordered susceptibility items load on one factor
one_factor_model <- paste0(
  "general_sus =~ ",
  paste(broad_sus_items, collapse = " + ")
)

fit_one_factor <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = one_factor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

summary(fit_one_factor, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# Statistics reported in Table 2
one_factor_fit <- lavaan::fitMeasures(
  fit_one_factor,
  c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled",
    "rmsea", "rmsea.ci.lower", "rmsea.ci.upper",
    "srmr", "cfi", "tli")
)
one_factor_fit
```
```{r Correlated product-specific model}
# Correlated product-specific factor model
product_factor_model <- '
  np_sus =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend
  cig_sus =~ cig_curious + cig_nextyear + cig_soon + cig_friend
  ecig_sus =~ ecig_curious + ecig_nextyear + ecig_soon + ecig_friend
  hookah_sus =~ hookah_curious + hookah_nextyear + hookah_soon + hookah_friend
  snus_sus =~ snus_curious + snus_nextyear + snus_soon + snus_friend
  smkls_sus =~ smkls_curious + smkls_nextyear + smkls_soon + smkls_friend
  cigar_sus =~ cigar_curious + cigar_nextyear + cigar_soon + cigar_friend
  cigarillo_sus =~ cigarillo_curious + cigarillo_nextyear + cigarillo_soon + cigarillo_friend
  fcigar_sus =~ fcigar_curious + fcigar_nextyear + fcigar_soon + fcigar_friend
'

fit_product_factors <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = product_factor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

summary(fit_product_factors, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# Fit measures
lavaan::fitMeasures(
  fit_product_factors,
  c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")
)
```
```{r Product factor correlations}
# Extract standardized latent factor correlations
std_product <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit_product_factors)

product_factor_correlations <- std_product %>%
  dplyr::filter(op == "~~", lhs != rhs) %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, rhs, est.std, pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(est.std))

product_factor_correlations

# Specifically inspect correlations involving nicotine pouch susceptibility
pouch_factor_correlations <- product_factor_correlations %>%
  dplyr::filter(lhs == "np_sus" | rhs == "np_sus") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(est.std))

pouch_factor_correlations
```
```{r Second-order general model}
general_factor_model <- '
  np_sus =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend
  cig_sus =~ cig_curious + cig_nextyear + cig_soon + cig_friend
  ecig_sus =~ ecig_curious + ecig_nextyear + ecig_soon + ecig_friend
  hookah_sus =~ hookah_curious + hookah_nextyear + hookah_soon + hookah_friend
  snus_sus =~ snus_curious + snus_nextyear + snus_soon + snus_friend
  smkls_sus =~ smkls_curious + smkls_nextyear + smkls_soon + smkls_friend
  cigar_sus =~ cigar_curious + cigar_nextyear + cigar_soon + cigar_friend
  cigarillo_sus =~ cigarillo_curious + cigarillo_nextyear + cigarillo_soon + cigarillo_friend
  fcigar_sus =~ fcigar_curious + fcigar_nextyear + fcigar_soon + fcigar_friend

  general_sus =~ np_sus + cig_sus + ecig_sus + hookah_sus +
                 snus_sus + smkls_sus + cigar_sus + cigarillo_sus + fcigar_sus
'

fit_general_factor <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = general_factor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

summary(fit_general_factor, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

lavaan::fitMeasures(
  fit_general_factor,
  c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))
```
```{r Bifactor model}
bifactor_model <- '
  # General susceptibility factor
  general_sus =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend +
                 cig_curious + cig_nextyear + cig_soon + cig_friend +
                 ecig_curious + ecig_nextyear + ecig_soon + ecig_friend +
                 hookah_curious + hookah_nextyear + hookah_soon + hookah_friend +
                 smkls_curious + smkls_nextyear + smkls_soon + smkls_friend +
                 snus_curious + snus_nextyear + snus_soon + snus_friend +
                 cigar_curious + cigar_nextyear + cigar_soon + cigar_friend +
                 cigarillo_curious + cigarillo_nextyear + cigarillo_soon + cigarillo_friend +
                 fcigar_curious + fcigar_nextyear + fcigar_soon + fcigar_friend

  # Product-specific residual factors
  np_specific =~ np_curious + np_nextyear + np_soon + np_friend
  cig_specific =~ cig_curious + cig_nextyear + cig_soon + cig_friend
  ecig_specific =~ ecig_curious + ecig_nextyear + ecig_soon + ecig_friend
  hookah_specific =~ hookah_curious + hookah_nextyear + hookah_soon + hookah_friend
  smkls_specific =~ smkls_curious + smkls_nextyear + smkls_soon + smkls_friend
  snus_specific =~ snus_curious + snus_nextyear + snus_soon + snus_friend
  cigar_specific =~ cigar_curious + cigar_nextyear + cigar_soon + cigar_friend
  cigarillo_specific =~ cigarillo_curious + cigarillo_nextyear + cigarillo_soon + cigarillo_friend
  fcigar_specific =~ fcigar_curious + fcigar_nextyear + fcigar_soon + fcigar_friend

  # Orthogonal factors
  general_sus ~~ 0*np_specific + 0*cig_specific + 0*ecig_specific +
                 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific +
                 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  np_specific ~~ 0*cig_specific + 0*ecig_specific + 0*hookah_specific +
                 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific +
                 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  cig_specific ~~ 0*ecig_specific + 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific +
                  0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific +
                  0*fcigar_specific

  ecig_specific ~~ 0*hookah_specific + 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific +
                   0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  hookah_specific ~~ 0*smkls_specific + 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific +
                     0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  smkls_specific ~~ 0*snus_specific + 0*cigar_specific +
                    0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  snus_specific ~~ 0*cigar_specific + 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  cigar_specific ~~ 0*cigarillo_specific + 0*fcigar_specific

  cigarillo_specific ~~ 0*fcigar_specific
'

fit_bifactor <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = bifactor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

summary(fit_bifactor, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

lavaan::fitMeasures(
  fit_bifactor,
  c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")
)
```

#Measurement invariance
```{r Measurement invariance, eval=FALSE, purl=FALSE}
# Ensure group is a factor
PATH_broad_sus_analytic$group <- factor(PATH_broad_sus_analytic$group)

# Configural invariance: same factor structure across groups
fit_general_config <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = general_factor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  group = "group",
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Threshold/loading invariance for ordered categorical items
fit_general_thresh <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = general_factor_model,
  data = PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  group = "group",
  ordered = broad_sus_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise",
  group.equal = c("loadings", "thresholds")
)

# Compare model fit
general_invariance_fit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    model = "Configural",
    t(lavaan::fitMeasures(
      fit_general_config,
      c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")
    ))
  ),
  data.frame(
    model = "Loadings + thresholds",
    t(lavaan::fitMeasures(
      fit_general_thresh,
      c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")
    ))
  )
)

general_invariance_fit <- general_invariance_fit %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(cfi, tli, rmsea, srmr), ~ round(.x, 3))
  )

general_invariance_fit

# Practical change in fit
general_invariance_delta <- general_invariance_fit %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    delta_cfi = cfi[model == "Loadings + thresholds"] - cfi[model == "Configural"],
    delta_tli = tli[model == "Loadings + thresholds"] - tli[model == "Configural"],
    delta_rmsea = rmsea[model == "Loadings + thresholds"] - rmsea[model == "Configural"],
    delta_srmr = srmr[model == "Loadings + thresholds"] - srmr[model == "Configural"]
  )

general_invariance_delta

# Chi-square difference test - expected to be sensitive with this sample size
lavaan::lavTestLRT(fit_general_config, fit_general_thresh)
```

```{r Test information function}
theta_grid <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 500)

test_info <- mirt::testinfo(
  fit_NP_grm,
  Theta = matrix(theta_grid, ncol = 1)
)

test_se <- 1 / sqrt(test_info)

NP_info_se_df <- data.frame(
  theta = theta_grid,
  test_info = test_info,
  se = test_se
)

# Scale SE to information range for plotting
scale_factor <- max(NP_info_se_df$test_info, na.rm = TRUE) /
  max(NP_info_se_df$se, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(NP_info_se_df, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = test_info, color = "Test Information"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = se * scale_factor, color = "Standard Error"),
            linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Test Information",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Standard Error")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Test Information" = "black", "Standard Error" = "gray40")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = expression(theta),
    color = NULL,
    title = "Test Information and Standard Error"
  )
```

```{r Product comparator Mokken}
product_mokken_results <- lapply(names(product_items_main), function(prod) {
  
  items <- product_items_main[[prod]]
  
  dat <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(items)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 100) return(NULL)
  
  h <- mokken::coefH(dat)
  
  data.frame(
    product = prod,
    product_label = product_labels[prod],
    n = nrow(dat),
    scale_H = as.numeric(h$H[1]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

product_mokken_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(product_mokken_results) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scale_H = round(scale_H, 3))

product_mokken_table
```
```{r Product comparator GRM}
fit_product_grm <- lapply(names(product_items_main), function(prod) {
  
  items <- product_items_main[[prod]]
  
  dat <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(items)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 100) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- mirt::mirt(
    data = dat,
    model = 1,
    itemtype = "graded",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  list(
    product = prod,
    product_label = unname(product_labels[prod]),
    n = nrow(dat),
    fit = fit
  )
})

names(fit_product_grm) <- names(product_items_main)
fit_product_grm <- fit_product_grm[!sapply(fit_product_grm, is.null)]
```
```{r Product comparator item parameters}
# Extract GRM item parameters for each product
product_grm_params <- lapply(fit_product_grm, function(x) {
  
  params <- mirt::coef(
    x$fit,
    IRTpars = TRUE,
    simplify = TRUE
  )$items %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("item_name")
  
  params %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      product = x$product,
      product_label = x$product_label,
      n = x$n,
      item_type = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(item_name, "curious") ~ "Curious",
        stringr::str_detect(item_name, "nextyear") ~ "Use in next year",
        stringr::str_detect(item_name, "soon") ~ "Try soon",
        stringr::str_detect(item_name, "friend") ~ "Best friend offered",
        TRUE ~ item_name
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      product,
      product_label,
      n,
      item_name,
      item_type,
      a,
      b1,
      b2,
      b3
    )
})

product_grm_param_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(product_grm_params) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(a, b1, b2, b3), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )
```

```{r Product IRT reporting tables}
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_discrimination_table <- product_discrimination_rank %>%
  dplyr::filter(rank <= 2) %>%
  dplyr::select(product_label, rank, item_type, a) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = rank,
    values_from = c(item_type, a),
    names_glue = "rank_{rank}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    most_discriminating_item = rank_1_item_type,
    most_discriminating_a = rank_1_a,
    second_discriminating_item = rank_2_item_type,
    second_discriminating_a = rank_2_a
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    most_discriminating_a = round(most_discriminating_a, 2),
    second_discriminating_a = round(second_discriminating_a, 2)
  )

top_discrimination_table

# Quick check: which item wins by product?
table(top_discrimination_table$most_discriminating_item)
```

```{r General susceptibility IRT information}
# Create item matrix for broad/general susceptibility IRT
general_irt_items <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(broad_sus_items)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.numeric))

# Keep rows with at least one susceptibility item answered
general_irt_items <- general_irt_items[
  rowSums(!is.na(general_irt_items)) > 0,
]

# Fit one-factor GRM across entire product universe
fit_general_grm <- mirt::mirt(
  data = general_irt_items,
  model = 1,
  itemtype = "graded",
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary(fit_general_grm)

# Test information and standard error
theta_grid <- seq(-3, 4, by = 0.05)

general_test_info <- mirt::testinfo(
  fit_general_grm,
  Theta = matrix(theta_grid)
)

general_test_se <- 1 / sqrt(general_test_info)

general_info_df <- data.frame(
  theta = theta_grid,
  test_info = general_test_info,
  se = general_test_se
)

# Plot test information and SE together
scale_factor <- max(general_info_df$test_info, na.rm = TRUE) /
  max(general_info_df$se, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot2::ggplot(general_info_df, ggplot2::aes(x = theta)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    ggplot2::aes(y = test_info, linetype = "Test information"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    ggplot2::aes(y = se * scale_factor, linetype = "Standard error"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Test Information",
    sec.axis = ggplot2::sec_axis(
      ~ . / scale_factor,
      name = "Standard Error"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Test information" = "solid",
      "Standard error" = "dashed"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "General Tobacco Susceptibility Test Information",
    x = expression(theta)
  )
```

```{r Short-form CFA models}
# Helper to extract fit measures as a clean one-row data frame
get_lavaan_fit <- function(fit, model_name) {
  fit_values <- lavaan::fitMeasures(
    fit,
    c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr")
  )

  data.frame(
    model = model_name,
    cfi = as.numeric(fit_values["cfi"]),
    tli = as.numeric(fit_values["tli"]),
    rmsea = as.numeric(fit_values["rmsea"]),
    srmr = as.numeric(fit_values["srmr"])
  )
}

# Next-year only: one general susceptibility factor
nextyear_model <- paste0(
  "general_sus =~ ",
  paste(short_nextyear_items, collapse = " + ")
)

nextyear_data <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(short_nextyear_items)))) > 0)

fit_nextyear <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = nextyear_model,
  data = nextyear_data,
  ordered = short_nextyear_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Try-soon only: one general susceptibility factor

trysoon_model <- paste0(
  "general_sus =~ ",
  paste(trysoon_items, collapse = " + ")
)

  dplyr::filter(rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(trysoon_items)))) > 0)

fit_trysoon <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = trysoon_model,
  data = trysoon_data,
  ordered = trysoon_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Next-year + try-soon: one general susceptibility factor

  "general_sus =~ ",
  paste(short_intention_items, collapse = " + ")
)

intention_data <- PATH_broad_sus_analytic %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(short_intention_items)))) > 0)

fit_intention <- lavaan::cfa(
  model = intention_model,
  data = intention_data,
  ordered = short_intention_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  missing = "pairwise"
)

# Summaries if needed

summary(fit_trysoon, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
summary(fit_intention, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r Short-form IRT information}
# Helper to fit general GRM and extract information curve
fit_short_grm_info <- function(data, items, label, theta_grid = seq(-3, 4, by = 0.05)) {
  item_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(items)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.numeric))

  item_data <- item_data[rowSums(!is.na(item_data)) > 0, ]

  fit <- mirt::mirt(
    data = item_data,
    model = 1,
    itemtype = "graded",
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  info <- mirt::testinfo(fit, Theta = matrix(theta_grid))

  list(
    fit = fit,
    info = data.frame(
      theta = theta_grid,
      test_info = info,
      form = label
    )
  )
}

full_grm_info <- fit_short_grm_info(
  PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  broad_sus_items,
  "Full 36-item form"
)

nextyear_grm_info <- fit_short_grm_info(
  PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  short_nextyear_items,
  "Next-year only"
)

intention_grm_info <- fit_short_grm_info(
  PATH_broad_sus_analytic,
  short_intention_items,
  "Next-year + try-soon"
)

short_form_info_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  full_grm_info$info,
  nextyear_grm_info$info,
  intention_grm_info$info
)

ggplot2::ggplot(
  short_form_info_df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = theta, y = test_info, color = form, linetype = form)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Test Information by Susceptibility Battery Length",
    x = expression(theta),
    y = "Test Information",
    color = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  )
```

```{r Try-soon OCC by product}
# Theta grid
theta_grid <- matrix(seq(-3, 4, by = 0.05))

# Extract OCCs for try-soon item from each product-specific GRM
trysoon_occ_list <- lapply(fit_product_grm, function(x) {
  item_names <- rownames(
    mirt::coef(x$fit, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items
  )

  trysoon_position <- which(stringr::str_detect(item_names, "_soon$"))

  probs <- mirt::probtrace(
    mirt::extract.item(x$fit, trysoon_position),
    Theta = theta_grid
  )

  probs_df <- as.data.frame(probs)
  colnames(probs_df) <- paste0("Response_", seq_len(ncol(probs_df)))

  probs_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      theta = as.vector(theta_grid),
      product = x$product,
      product_label = x$product_label
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::starts_with("Response_"),
      names_to = "response",
      values_to = "probability"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      response = dplyr::case_when(
        response == "Response_1" ~ "Definitely not",
        response == "Response_2" ~ "Probably not",
        response == "Response_3" ~ "Probably yes",
        response == "Response_4" ~ "Definitely yes",
        TRUE ~ response
      ),
      response = factor(
        response,
        levels = c(
          "Definitely not",
          "Probably not",
          "Probably yes",
          "Definitely yes"
        )
      )
    )
})

trysoon_occ_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(trysoon_occ_list)

# Plot OCCs by product
ggplot2::ggplot(
  trysoon_occ_df,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = theta,
    y = probability,
    color = response,
    linetype = response
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ product_label, ncol = 3) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 4), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Option Characteristic Curves for Try-Soon Items",
    x = expression(theta),
    y = "Response Probability",
    color = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  )
```
